title: Mother in Cloche Hat, Two Sons on Park Bench - Vintage 1920s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A full-length outdoor portrait from the late 1920s featuring a stylish young mother seated on a curved stone or concrete park bench with her two young children. She is wearing a classic Roaring Twenties cloche hat, a patterned coat or cardigan dress, and cross-strap Mary Jane shoes, holding an infant on her lap. Next to her sits a smiling young boy in short trousers, a collared short-sleeve shirt, and buckled shoes. Behind them is a lush, tropical or subtropical garden background thick with palm fronds, tall trees, and blooming flora, suggesting a botanical park or conservatory outing.
